entities.name: Query HldE-like protein
observations: 485 aa; estimated molecular mass 52.2 kDa and theoretical pI 6.43.
Sequence has an N-terminal PfkB domain at residues 13–308 and a C-terminal CTP-transferase-like domain at residues 351–476.
High-confidence homology to reviewed HldE proteins: 47.3–54.7% identity over 97.7–98.4% query coverage.

Likely bifunctional enzyme in ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthesis; exact substrate stereochemistry remains homology-supported rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.
Predicted soluble/cytosolic enzyme; no transmembrane segment or signal peptide was reported.

entities.name: HldE
observations: Reviewed HldE homologs catalyze two steps in ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthesis.
EC 2.7.1.167: heptose-7-phosphate kinase activity, forming D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose-1,7-bisphosphate from the 7-phosphate and ATP.
EC 2.7.7.70: heptose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity, forming ADP-D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose from the 1-phosphate and ATP.
Reviewed homolog annotations specify cytosolic localization and homodimeric assembly.

entities.name: ADP-heptose biosynthesis
observations: HldE participates in steps 1 and 3 of the four-step ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthetic pathway, a nucleotide-sugar/carbohydrate metabolism route.

entities.name: Heptose-7-phosphate kinase reaction
observations: D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 7-phosphate + ATP → D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 1,7-bisphosphate + ADP + H+; Rhea RHEA:27473; EC 2.7.1.167.
Reaction is supported by multiple reviewed HldE homolog annotations, not direct assay of the query sequence.

entities.name: Heptose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase reaction
observations: D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose 1-phosphate + ATP + H+ → ADP-D-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose + diphosphate; Rhea RHEA:27465; EC 2.7.7.70.
Reaction is supported by multiple reviewed HldE homolog annotations, not direct assay of the query sequence.
